stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Older students learned patience and clearer thinking.”?
options: It became a place where people learned how to keep living things alive after taking them home.
The library became quieter without Page, but everyone knew it now had a warmer home.
A book can travel through a screen, but a library is also a place.
The library became a place where knowledge moved in two directions, not just from older to younger.
